# TC-CLI-301 压缩 + 加密备份与还原（FR-12、FR-13、FR-17）：口令只经 stdin；
# 错误口令 → 退出码 3 E_AUTH、缺口令 → 3 E_PASSWORD_REQUIRED，二者都不创建还原目录；
# 正确口令还原后五要素一致；口令不出现在任何输出中。

stdin pw.txt
exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name sec --compress huffman --encrypt aes256 --password-stdin
stdout '"command":"backup","name":"sec",.*"compressed":true,"encrypted":true,'
! stdout correct-horse
! stderr correct-horse

stdin bad.txt
exec expect 3 --json restore --backup sec --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/out --password-stdin
stdout '^\{"type":"error","code":"E_AUTH","message":"口令错误或备份已被篡改"\}$'
! exists $WORK/out

exec expect 3 --json restore --backup sec --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/out
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_PASSWORD_REQUIRED"'
! exists $WORK/out

stdin pw.txt
exec databackup --json restore --backup sec.dbk --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/out --password-stdin
stdout '"command":"restore",.*"files":2,"dirs":1,'
! stdout correct-horse
treeeq src out

-- pw.txt --
correct-horse
-- bad.txt --
wrong-horse
-- src/notes.txt --
DataBackup DataBackup DataBackup DataBackup DataBackup DataBackup DataBackup
-- src/sub/data.csv --
id,name
1,alpha
2,beta
